newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain seen keeping rate unchanged - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain seen keeping rate unchanged - poll.

text.p: The Bank of Spain is likely to keep its key money rate unchanged at 6.75 percent on Tuesday at its regular repo auction, a Reuter poll forecast.
All 10 financial experts polled by Reuters on Monday ruled out a reduction, many saying the central bank was now watching inflation developments carefully.

In September the consumer price index rose a lower-than-expected 0.2 percent after a 0.3 percent rise in August. Year-on-year inflation fell to 3.6 percent from 3.7 percent in August. October CPI data are due on November 14.

On October 3, the Bank of Spain cut the rate by 50 basis points to 6.75 percent, backing the government's austere 1997 budget package with its sixth official rate reduction this year. The rate started the year at nine percent.
